title: ÆTHER: Sunrise Highway (festival anthem, 3 min)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: A euphoric, uplifting progressive house festival anthem, 3 minutes, 128 BPM, bright major key, pure joy and freedom: friends driving an open highway at sunrise. Big emotional piano chords, bright supersaw synths, a punchy four-on-the-floor kick, claps, rolling bass, soaring strings. ONE huge singalong hook in D major pentatonic (D E F# A B), phrased like a singer with quick slides into the high notes, sung back by a big crowd of wordless 'oh-oh-oh' voices. Timeline: 0-25 s: emotional piano chords and a soft wordless female voice sing the hook. 25-55 s: kick and bass join, the build rises with snare rolls and rising strings. 55-85 s: the first drop: massive supersaw lead plays the hook, the crowd chant answers, full energy. 85-115 s: a breakdown with piano, strings and the female voice, warm and emotional, then a long rising build. 115-155 s: the biggest drop, supersaws, crowd chant, strings and a bansuri all on the hook together. 155-180 s: the energy settles back to the piano and the crowd humming the hook, a final big chord. Real instruments named as themselves are played by real musicians, close, natural and dry, no heavy echo. No white-noise risers, no side-chain pumping on acoustic instruments, no long gaps, no fade-out at the start, no words unless stated.

brief.notes: Big-room / progressive house euphoria with a crowd singalong hook (traits from the 2026 festival anthems and the classic singalong anthems). Bright major key, Mohanam in D. No key lift (lesson: ElevenLabs slides through clashing chords). Prompt mode, 180 s, 2 takes, one at a time.

story: Three friends drive out of the city at dawn on an open highway, windows down, singing, as the sun rises over the ghats.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
